subject.title: Actualizar layout de pagina de producto

question: Should this PDP redesign land as one coordinated feature PR or be split into smaller PRs for breadcrumb/details, author block, and best-seller carousel?
rationale: The request is clear but spans visual layout, enriched data, cache behavior, and copy, so maintainers should decide the implementation boundary before a repair worker starts.

options.title: Split into focused PRs
options.body: Land the low-risk breadcrumb/details work separately from the author-data and best-seller carousel work.

options.title: One coordinated PDP PR
options.body: Implement the full layout in one feature branch with stronger browser proof and product review before merge.

recommendation.title: Split into focused PRs
recommendation.body: Land the low-risk breadcrumb/details work separately from the author-data and best-seller carousel work.

likelyOwner.reason: Most closely tied to the current PDP variant implementation history.
